stage_2_story.text_en:
Last Tuesday, Yossi decided to go to the bank to sort out some financial matters. He had been putting it off for weeks. When he arrived, a friendly clerk greeted him and asked how she could help.

First, Yossi asked to check his account balance. The clerk told him he had three thousand and two hundred dollars. He was relieved — there was enough money to cover his bills.

Next, Yossi made a cash withdrawal of three hundred dollars for his daughter's school trip. He entered his PIN carefully at the counter and the transaction went through without any problems.

After that, he asked about taking out a loan to repair the roof of his house. The clerk explained the interest rate — it was four and a half percent per year. She printed out a statement showing all his recent transactions and told him to bring it if he decided to apply for the loan.

Finally, Yossi asked about setting up a monthly bank transfer to automatically pay his electricity bill. The clerk showed him how to do it on the bank's mobile app. He thanked her, put his documents in his bag, and walked out feeling organised and calm for the first time in weeks.
